free_text: The guideline criterion strongly supports re-biopsy due to the PI-RADS 4 lesion, which is weighted as decisive. This decision is further supported by the documented upward PSA trajectory from 8.4 ng/mL to 9.2 ng/mL following a prior negative biopsy. The evidence converges on the need for further sampling to evaluate the suspicious lesion identified on the mpMRI.
